Engineering Job in Bank 2572 views Q. My question is regarding Ribba. I ama government employee. We have to contribute a specific percentage of salary to Provident fund. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 156197 Country: India Title: DSA agent of home loan...only sourcing customer to bank and getting commission in % on loan amount? Question: I am not working in any bank but I have DSA (direct source agency) of some banks we are just completing home loan documentation formalities and banks giving us commission for sourcing customers so is it haram or halal? We are on commission basis not on salary basis. Answer ID: 156197 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 312/273/H=2/1439) It is not lawful to complete the home loan documentation formalities as well as receiving charges over it from the bank is not lawful since this charge is unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
